title: Renaissance (Documentary)
quote: And yet it seemed like a spiritual home. And in many ways, it was far more real than this world.

title: The near-death experience of Jeff Olsen
quote: It's odd what was coming to my mind, Wow, it's good to be home! I was home. I mean, people say heaven or the other side. To me, I was home. It was so familiar. It was so welcoming. I was so joyful to be there.

title: The near-death experience of Heidi Craig
quote: When I woke up, I was in heaven. I like to call it home.
phrase: I like to call it home

title: The near-death experience of Ingrid Honkala
quote: For the first time in these three years of my life, I felt that I was home. So it was the sense of like, ah, I'm finally home. Actually this experience was more real than this reality, and I felt that I was being welcomed.

title: The near-death experiences of Bill McDonald
quote: I didn't have any questions for anybody there was nothing I didn't feel I knew I'm back I'm back home

experiencer: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
title: The near death experience of Karen Thomas
quote: A lot of us who've had near-death experiences call it—it's like a homesickness, in terms of that is home. What I experienced there is home, and at a level that is beyond what we think of when we think of home here in this life.

experiencer: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
title: The near-death experience of Jane Thompson
quote: It almost started feeling like my life was becoming a distant memory. It felt so much like home to be in that light that there was no other place I wanted to be at that point. There's no place that feels as good as that light feels.

experiencer: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
title: The near death experience of Tammy Lee Anderson
quote: This experience is more real than real. It's home, and I remember it like yesterday.

experiencer: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
title: The near death experience of Nancy Rynes
quote: and the voice said welcome home this is your home you know you're a part of us you're a part of this you know you're a part of me welcome home and i just lost it okay i almost lose it like that every time i talk i tell people about this because it was just so moving and it was so welcoming and i'd never felt in my entire life i'd never felt that welcomed anywhere not as much as i was being welcomed wherever this was that i was in now

title: The near death experience of Deborah King
quote: I want to be here. I am home. I know that this is where I came from and now I'm back here and there's nothing that's ever going to get me to leave here.
